Kambal, Karibal is a riveting tale of family and love that also transcends into the supernatural realm.

It tells the story of twins Crisanta and Criselda. Unfortunately, Criselda dies because of a rare disease and remains a spirit that only appears to Crisanta. Now that she is “alive”, she is stopping at nothing to take both her mother’s affection and Diego’s love.
